zh.title: 波音延攬GOL執行長Ferrer出任拉丁美洲總裁；GOL任命Fehlauer接任執行長
zh.summary: 波音聘GOL執行長Celso Ferrer任拉丁美洲及加勒比地區總裁；GOL任命André Fehlauer接任執行長
body: 2026年8月13日，波音宣布延攬巴西低成本航空GOL Linhas Aéreas執行長Celso Ferrer，擔任拉丁美洲及加勒比地區總裁。Ferrer將於2026年9月4日加入波音，負責強化波音在該區域的營運、策略與業務布局。
Ferrer自2022年起擔任GOL執行長，任內督導公司重整及與Abra Group的整合。他於2004年以實習生身分加入GOL，在該航空任職超過20年，此前亦曾擔任營運長及規劃副總裁。GOL表示，Ferrer持有波音737-700、737-800 Next Generation及737-8 Max的飛行員資格。
Ferrer將於2026年8月31日卸任GOL執行長。GOL隨後宣布任命André Fehlauer自2026年9月起接任執行長。Fehlauer此前曾在GOL旗下Smiles忠誠度計畫於阿根廷及巴西任職八年，最近擔任巴西忠誠度計畫Livelo執行長。
此外，GOL現任商務長Albert Perez將擴大職責，兼任GOL Linhas Aéreas總裁。Perez於2024年初加入GOL，此前在Avianca、JetSMART及Vueling等航空擔任領導職務。GOL表示，Perez協助改善營運表現，將繼續負責日常營運。
Abra Group執行長Adrian Neuhauser表示，Fehlauer在GOL的過往經驗及Perez的營運背景將支持GOL下一階段的成長。GOL為Abra Group旗下航空，該集團同時擁有Avianca，並對Wamos Air持有策略投資，另持有Sky Airline的少數可轉換債權。

en.title: Boeing recruits GOL CEO Celso Ferrer as Latin America president; GOL names André Fehlauer as new CEO
en.summary: Boeing appoints GOL CEO Celso Ferrer as Latin America and Caribbean president; GOL names André Fehlauer as new CEO from September 2026
body: On August 13, 2026, Boeing announced that it had recruited Celso Ferrer, CEO of Brazilian low-cost airline GOL Linhas Aéreas, as its new president for Latin America and the Caribbean. Ferrer is due to join Boeing on September 4, 2026, and will be responsible for strengthening Boeing's operations, strategy, and presence across the region.

Ferrer has served as CEO of GOL Linhas Aéreas since 2022, having joined the carrier in 2004 as an intern. During his tenure he oversaw a restructuring of the company and its integration with Abra Group. He previously held the roles of Chief Operating Officer and Vice President of Planning at the airline.

Ferrer will step down from GOL on August 31, 2026. GOL named André Fehlauer as its new CEO, effective September 2026. Fehlauer is returning to GOL after previously spending eight years with the airline's Smiles loyalty business in Argentina and Brazil. He most recently served as CEO of Livelo, a Brazilian loyalty program.

Additionally, Albert Perez, currently GOL's Chief Commercial Officer, will take on expanded responsibilities as president of GOL Linhas Aéreas. Perez joined GOL in early 2024 after more than two decades in aviation, including leadership roles at Avianca, JetSMART, and Vueling. GOL said he has helped improve the airline's operational performance.

Abra Group CEO Adrian Neuhauser said Fehlauer's previous experience with GOL and Perez's operational background would support the airline's next phase of growth. GOL is part of Abra Group, which also owns Avianca and holds a strategic investment in Wamos Air, as well as convertible debt representing a minority interest in Sky Airline.
